question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.
sql:
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT txn_date) as distinct_days,
    MIN(txn_date) as first_date,
    MAX(txn_date) as last_date
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_records DESC
LIMIT 50

```sql
WITH daily_balances AS (
    -- Calculate running balance for each customer per day
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
ordered_transactions AS (
    -- Add row number per customer per day
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as rn,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as txn_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as txn_month
    FROM daily_balances
),
rolling_averages AS (
    -- Calculate 30-day rolling average (only after 30 days of data)
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        tn_year,
        txn_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN rn >= 30 THEN 
                AVG(running_balance) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY customer_id 
                    ORDER BY txn_date 
                    ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END as thirty_day_avg
    FROM ordered_transactions
),
valid_averages AS (
    -- Filter to only rows with valid 30-day average (and treat negative as zero)
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_month,
        tn_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN thirty_day_avg IS NOT NULL THEN thirty_day_avg ELSE 0 END) as thirty_day_avg
    FROM rolling_averages
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date, txn_month, tn_year
),
monthly_max AS (
    -- Group by month and customer, find max 30-day avg per customer per month
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_month,
        MAX(thirty_day_avg) as max_30day_avg
    FROM valid_averages
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_month
),
excluded_first_month AS (
    -- Exclude first month per customer
    SELECT 
        mm.customer_id,
        mm.txn_month,
        mm.max_30day_avg
    FROM monthly_max mm
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM monthly_max mm2
        WHERE mm2.customer_id = mm.customer_id
        AND mm2.txn_month = mm.txn_month - 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
    SUM(max_30day_avg) as total_max_30day_avg
FROM excluded_first_month
GROUP BY month
```

WITH daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
ordered_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as rn,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date_dt,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as txn_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as txn_year
    FROM daily_balances
),
rolling_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_date_dt,
        txn_month,
        txn_year,
        CASE 
            WHEN rn >= 30 THEN 
                AVG(running_balance) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY customer_id 
                    ORDER BY txn_date 
                    ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END as thirty_day_avg
    FROM ordered_transactions
),
valid_averages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_date_dt,
        txn_month,
        txn_year,
        thirty_day_avg
    FROM rolling_averages
    WHERE thirty_day_avg IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_month,
        txn_year,
        MAX(thirty_day_avg) as max_30day_avg
    FROM valid_averages
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_month, txn_year
),
first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_month) as first_month
    FROM monthly_max
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
excluded_first_month AS (
    SELECT mm.*
    FROM monthly_max mm
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM first_month fm 
        WHERE fm.customer_id = mm.customer_id 
        AND fm.first_month = mm.txn_month
    )
)
SELECT 
    txn_month,
    txn_year,
    SUM(max_30day_avg) as total_max_30day_avg
FROM excluded_first_month
GROUP BY txn_month, txn_year
ORDER BY txn_year, txn_month
